'''Jerik Snivas''' was a former [[Detective/Legends|investigator]] for [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]] (IOCI). He worked many years and was promoted to an important position in the local office on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. However, years of shady dealings led him to leave IOCI to avoid being investigated and prosecuted. He became a free-lance expediter where his connections allowed him to stay in business.

He was not particularly interesting, but had an intense personality and tendency to chatter non-stop which would often cause people to be drawn to him. He was utterly selfish and cared only for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. He believed information was valuable, and he was a master at trading it.
